C0905.title: Shen Illegally Added In-Game Currency Case
C0905.summary: From January to June 2019, Shen, an operations supervisor at a gaming company, abused his position by altering backend data without authorization to add large amounts of in-game currency to multiple player accounts, secretly collecting over 150,000 yuan from players. The court convicted him of embezzlement and sentenced him to three years in prison.

references.title: Case study | Judicial determination of illegally obtaining virtual items such as in-game currency
